tiger-city.description: An evening at Tiger City can pair dinner and a film with the changing lineup of events on its outdoor plaza. This mix of moviegoing and an open-air gathering place gives the Xitun complex a distinctive place in Taichung’s evening scene. Take the glass elevator for a view over the square, then walk a few minutes to nearby Maple Garden.
tiger-city.descriptionZh: 在老虎城，可以把晚餐、看電影與戶外廣場不定期推出的活動排成一個晚上的行程。影城與開放式廣場相連，讓這個西屯去處在臺中的夜間生活裡別具特色。搭上玻璃景觀電梯俯瞰廣場，再走一小段路，就能到秋紅谷散步。

rainbow-village.description: The low houses of Rainbow Village once housed military families in Nantun. When the neighborhood faced demolition, retired soldier and resident Huang Yong-Fu began painting his home and the walls around it. Bright figures and patterns spread down the lanes, and public support helped persuade the city to preserve the painted cluster. Huang became known as Rainbow Grandpa. The narrow lanes and single-story roofs still show how the old community was laid out.
rainbow-village.descriptionZh: 彩虹眷村原是南屯的軍眷聚落。面對拆遷，住在這裡的退伍軍人黃永阜開始在自家和鄰近牆面畫畫。人物與鮮豔的圖案一路延伸到巷弄，引起民眾關注，市府最後保留了彩繪聚落。黃永阜也因此有了「彩虹爺爺」的暱稱。沿著窄巷看屋頂和一整排低矮房舍，仍可辨認老眷村的生活尺度。

jingming-street.description: Jingming 1st Street is a pedestrian lane about 100 meters long between Dadun 19th Street and Dalong Road. Cafés set tables out along the walkway, among boutiques, restaurants and galleries. It was the first street in Taichung picked as a model shopping street by Taiwan’s commerce authority. The shopping district also extends onto Dalong Road, while the original lane is still small enough to take in from one end.
jingming-street.descriptionZh: 精明一街位於西區大墩十九街與大隆路之間，是一條約百公尺長的徒步街。精品店、餐館與藝廊沿街排列，咖啡館則把桌椅擺到步道旁。這裡是臺中第一條獲經濟部商業司選為示範商店街的街道。商圈後來延伸到大隆路，原本的小街仍保有一眼就能望到另一端的尺度。

city-hall.description: Taichung’s City Hall faces Taiwan Boulevard across a wide public square. A tall central passage sits between the Huizhong and Wenxin wings. Near their side entrances, the red letters of Tower of Words form an open, curved sculpture. On the ground floor of the Huizhong wing, Taichung Vision Hall uses exhibits about the city’s history, neighborhoods and civic projects to explain how Taichung grew and what the city is planning next.
city-hall.descriptionZh: 臺中市政府臺灣大道市政大樓前方有一座開闊的廣場，挑高的中央川堂連接惠中樓與文心樓。側門附近的公共藝術〈塔之語〉由紅色字母拼成半蛋形。惠中樓一樓的臺中願景館透過城市歷史、地方生活與市政建設等展覽，介紹臺中如何發展成今天的樣子，以及這座城市正在規劃的未來。

central-park.description: Taichung Central Park occupies the former grounds of Shuinan Airport. Part of the runway survives, a reminder of the airfield beneath today’s landscape. Paths and cycle routes cross about 67 hectares of groves, open lawns and ponds. The park’s twelve interactive installations explore senses and abilities such as touch and balance. At the northern edge, the Green Museumbrary’s shaded plazas open directly onto the park.
central-park.descriptionZh: 臺中中央公園位在水湳機場原址，園內保留了一部分跑道，讓人還能看出這裡曾是機場。約六十七公頃的園區裡，步道與自行車道穿過林地、草坪與水池，十二處感官互動設施則讓人透過觸覺、平衡感等方式體驗不同的地景。走到公園北側，就能看見臺中綠美圖向公園敞開的遮蔭廣場。

green-museumbrary.description: The Green Museumbrary brings the Taichung Art Museum and the city’s public library together at the north end of Central Park. SANAA and Taiwan’s Ricky Liu & Associates designed eight linked volumes wrapped in silvery metal mesh. Parts of the complex rise above the ground to make shaded plazas where the park paths meet the building. The galleries, reading rooms and rooftop garden offer different views of the park.
green-museumbrary.descriptionZh: 臺中綠美圖位於中央公園北端，結合臺中市立美術館與臺中市立圖書館。日本 SANAA 與臺灣的劉培森建築師事務所共同設計了八座彼此相連的量體，外側覆以銀白色金屬網。部分空間抬高，讓公園步道接上底下的遮蔭廣場。從展廳、閱讀空間到屋頂花園，都能看到公園不同的面貌。

baseball-stadium.description: Taichung Intercontinental Ballpark opened in Beitun in 2006, and its first major event was the Intercontinental Cup. The stadium sits at the junction of Chongde and Huanzhong roads. Its broad stands look across the diamond, and the curved roof borrows its shape from the stitches on a baseball. The ballpark has hosted international games ever since and remains a fixture of Taiwan’s baseball scene.
baseball-stadium.descriptionZh: 臺中洲際棒球場位在北屯崇德路與環中路口，於二〇〇六年完工，首場大型賽事便是洲際盃棒球賽。寬敞的看台望向球場，弧形屋頂的設計則取自棒球的縫線。從啟用以來，這裡陸續迎來多場國際比賽，也是臺灣棒球迷熟悉的場地。

folklore-park.description: Taiwan’s first folklore park opened in Beitun in 1990. Its tiled roofs and courtyards draw on the Minnan homes built around the end of the Qing dynasty. The museum displays objects from everyday life and shows how families arranged their rooms, while the park’s squares make room for folk crafts and performances. Covered walkways, arched bridges and a lotus pond carry the same attention to local traditions into the grounds.
folklore-park.descriptionZh: 北屯民俗公園於一九九〇年開放，是臺灣第一座民俗公園。瓦屋頂與四合院取材自清末民初的閩南建築。民俗館透過早期家庭的日常器物與室內陳設，呈現當時的居家生活，園內廣場也為民間工藝與表演留出空間。出了館舍，還能沿著迴廊走過拱橋、花圃與荷塘。

national-trade-center.description: Across from the National Taichung Theater, National Trade Center rises like a bamboo shoot, narrowing toward the top. Aedas shaped this Xitun office tower with an oval outline, folded glass curtain walls and layered horizontal rain shades. From street level, those stacked bands are a clear clue to its bamboo-inspired design.
national-trade-center.descriptionZh: 國家歌劇院對面的NTC國家商貿中心，像竹筍般向上收尖。Aedas以橢圓輪廓、摺面玻璃帷幕與層層水平雨遮，塑造這棟西屯商辦大樓。從街道望去，一圈圈堆疊的線條，就是辨認竹筍造型的線索。
national-trade-center.officialSourceTitle: National Trade Center — place and address map

ding-sheng-bhw.description: Ding Sheng BHW rises 36 stories at the corner of Henan Road and Shizheng North 2nd Road in Xitun. Stone panels and glass curtain walls define its exterior, while a planted setback lines the frontage. Look for that green edge as you walk around the base of the tower.
ding-sheng-bhw.descriptionZh: 鼎盛BHW位在西屯河南路與市政北二路轉角，是一棟地上三十六層的商辦大樓。外牆結合石材與玻璃帷幕，臨街退縮處則留有植栽綠帶。沿著人行道經過時，可以從大樓腳下的綠意認出這處街角。
ding-sheng-bhw.officialSourceTitle: Ding Sheng BHW — place and address map

yuanbao-temple.description: Completed in 1791, Yuanbao Temple stands on Meichuan West Road in Taichung’s North District. The Lai family came from Pinghe, Fujian, and brought their devotion to Baosheng Dadi from Xintian Temple. Seventeen villages helped build the temple.
yuanbao-temple.descriptionZh: 元保宮位於臺中市北區梅川西路，於1791年落成。來自福建平和的賴氏族人，從心田宮迎來保生大帝香火，並與十七庄信眾合力興建廟宇。

location.address: No. 109, Sec. 3, Meichuan W. Rd., North District, Taichung City
location.addressZh: 臺中市北區梅川西路三段109號

the-lin.description: THE LIN Hotel stands on Chaofu Road in Xitun, near the National Taichung Theater and Maple Garden. Its design combines modern forms with castle-inspired details. The real building is a working hotel.
the-lin.descriptionZh: 林酒店位於西屯朝富路，鄰近國家歌劇院與秋紅谷。建築融合現代造型與古堡式細節；現實中的這棟建築是一間營運中的飯店。

location.address: No. 99, Chaofu Rd., Xitun District, Taichung City
location.addressZh: 臺中市西屯區朝富路99號
